visualReview.notes: Inspected the site preview, four rotations and four named views of the trapezoid airside clerestory, lobby and auditorium, large reserve aircraft doors and the sloped reserve curtain wall. The delta hall and barrel-roof hangar retained separate as-built footprints.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected nine dated shared-material views including the bounded geographic placement. The retained metal and concrete finishes and tinted glazing display with their intended material bindings. The flat geographic fixture unloaded successfully. The original field was checked separately.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all twenty-five context and detail views. Each level preserves both main buildings, the distinctive run of dark trapezoid clerestory windows, stepped visitor and service sections, and the broad curved reserve roof. Close views resolve curtain wall mullions and the two aircraft doors.

geographicReview.notes: The matched native building geometry is signed against the runway-side elevation. The main footprint, reserve hangar and adjacent service enclosure follow the frozen 512 m source field with sampled foundations. The original unmasked field and the model review scene were inspected. Foundation and door approach heights are approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: The airport-facing delta museum hall at Rockcliffe, including the mapped public addition and auditorium and the separate curved reserve hangar. Include the abutting lower service hangar, with airfield vehicles and aircraft displays outside the model scope.
fidelityReview.notes: The 2005 Qualla aerial shows the delta exhibition hall and the pale reserve hangar; the 2006 airside view shows the trapezoid clerestory and long window ribbons. The 2024 CC0 photo supports the lighter current cladding and canopy finish. The builder and visitor addition designer describe the roof profile, curtain wall, reserve doors and 2010 visitor work. The precise entrance canopy and assignments of reserve wall features are estimated.

imageryReview.notes: Inspected exact Qualla files by Ahunt and David Megginson, each explicitly dedicated to the public domain, and a 2024 CC0 own-work file by AdoTang. The three bytestrings match the native Commons checksums. The 2024 photograph establishes selected exterior finish details only.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: The April 2024 airport-side Canada Aviation and Space Museum with native delta main hall and additions, auditorium, attached service volume and the reserve hangar.

limitations: OpenStreetMap sets four current envelopes including the auditorium part. The delta deck and clerestory profiles of the main hangar are estimated from the older cleared Qualla airfield photographs.

The 2024 cleared photo shows partial exterior finishes. Entrance canopy, window spacing, visitor and service roof transitions and the location of reserve glazing and sliding doors are estimates based on native plans and written project descriptions.
The authoring model represents April 2024. Aircraft, parking and airfield vehicles, signs, interior exhibitions and neighboring airfield buildings are outside its scope.
The frozen airport terrain establishes local contact; foundations bridge the small grade differences. Floor elevations and access apron grades are approximate.
